_comment: Register Verdict's read-only forensic MCP server with Claude Code. Copy the 'verdict' block into your Claude Code MCP config (project .mcp.json or ~/.claude/mcp.json). Install the package first with 'pip install -e .' from the repo root (or set PYTHONPATH=src). Set EVIDENCE_DIR/LOG_DIR to your case paths and TOOL_* to the forensic binaries on your SIFT host (see .env.example).
